info.title: Stratio Rocket
info.description: Stratio Rocket is a tool of Stratio Data-centric that allows you to gather different entry data to, afterward, group, transform, and operate with it. When the desired operations are done, this data is stored in different output elements. All these steps are done continuously and in real time.

The contents of the zip should be: 1. a top level 'summary.json' file with the asset names, groups and version numbers of the imported asset and its dependencies. 2. These inner folders, either for the exported asset versions or their dependencies, contain two JSON files, 'info.json' and 'exported.json', along with extra binary files depending on the type of asset or dependecy exported (MlModels, MlTrainers, MlProjects or Extensions).
